summary: Made the desktop games height-aware and audited PC overlays and mode changes.
reason: The fixed 640px desktop cap still let tall pages scroll on a 1000px-high window, and computer/local modes add a toolbar row that had not been checked at desktop size.
decisions: Use a centred desktop column of clamp(440px, calc(100svh - 460px), 640px).
Keep page-specific desktop budgets for Crazy 8, Cribbage, Lost Cities, Blokus Duo, Onitama and Quoridor.
Hide Crazy 8's duplicate bottom hint and in-page guide only at desktop width.

summary: Adopted repository-native agent memory with a current-state summary, JSONL events and decision records.
reason: Agents share one OpenCode harness and working tree. A service or vector database would add concurrency and operational surface before there is evidence it is needed.
decisions: The parent agent is the single memory writer; subagents return handoffs.
Events are append-only context, while Git and fresh test output remain authoritative.
Commit is nullable while the worktree is dirty; worktree_state records the condition.
Do not add a vector database or memory service until search size or concurrent top-level writers require it.

known_issues: The memory system relies on the parent agent updating CURRENT.md at material handoffs.
Parallel top-level agents would need a lock or one-file-per-event storage.

summary: Fixed search.mjs treating --file as the event-log path instead of a changed-file filter.
reason: The first search script used --file for two different things. Passing --file fun.css made it read the CSS file as JSONL and print a warning for every line.
decisions: Keep --file as the record filter and use --log for an alternate event-log path.

summary: Added a compact layer for short desktop screens at 1366×768, keeping the phone-first one-column layout and leaving normal desktop above 899px unchanged.
reason: At 1366×768, 27 of the 57 phone-first games still scrolled. The user chose a compact desktop layer over shrinking boards further or accepting scrolling, while requiring the phone layout to remain unchanged.
decisions: Compact layer applies only at (min-width: 760px) and (max-height: 899px) and (min-height: 480px); normal desktop above 899px is unchanged.
Compact wrap is clamp(360px, calc(100svh - 368px), 440px); the layout stays a centred one-column game.
Compact chrome is a 44px topbar, 8px/12px wrap padding, 42px/36px message zones, 36px Options/toolbar controls and 12px hints.
Crazy 8 subtracts 8px and Quoridor subtracts 47px from the compact column; Ludo's custom 48px score bar is accepted.
The 480px height floor excludes landscape phones; desktop-phone-guard checks 844×390.

summary: Finished the short-screen/PC follow-up: Hangman expression range and victory sequence, the new 42-level Car Park game, share-panel and message-strip order, Battleship overscroll fix, back/Home pressed feedback, viewport/keyboard/load coverage, icon-check alignment and four Commentary blocks.
reason: The compact desktop layer had landed but the TODO still carried open PC-layout fixes, the Hangman face did not match his lines, a flawless win moved an invisible body, and Car Park was only a backlog idea.
decisions: Every Hangman line pool has one expression; data-face overrides the miss-count mood and its body animation, so praise is never delivered while shaking.
A save draws the missing body parts, retracts the noose and drops the completed man; reduced motion keeps the final state without movement.
The WhatsApp share panel lives below the board and the message strip stays above it, so neither the board nor the page height jumps.
Back/Home get touch-action: manipulation, an :active scale and a pointerdown-driven gk-pressed class.
Car Park levels are BFS-verified and their stored par is the exact minimum.
The app-icon check follows the shipped flat cream art; the final icon choice remains a user decision.
